summary: GoldMining Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the commencement of a fully-funded 1,200-meter exploration drilling program at its 100%-owned Yarumalito Gold-Copper Project in Colombia. The program includes up to four core holes targeting the P-1 porphyry and epithermal veins, building on historical intercepts such as 257m at 0.50 g/t Au from surface. The filing is a routine operational update and does not involve any transaction, board recommendation, or special-situation event. It is a standard progress report typical for a mineral exploration company.
